problem: The vector $u$ has magnitude $7$, the vector $v$ has magnitude $7,$ the angle between $u$ and $v$ is ${117}^{∘}$ and $n$ is the unit vector that points in the direction of $u\times v.$ Find $u\times v$ in terms of $n.$ Round your final answer to one decimal place where appropriate.

feedback.problem: The vector $u$ has magnitude $8$, the vector $v$ has magnitude $2,$ the angle between $u$ and $v$ is ${100}^{∘}$ and $n$ is the unit vector that points in the direction of $u\times v.$ Find $u\times v$ in terms of $n.$ Round your final answer to one decimal place where appropriate.
feedback.worked_solution:
We use the formula for the cross product and obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}u\times v & =|u|\cdot |v|\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡\theta \cdot n \\  & =8\cdot 2\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{100}^{∘}\cdot n \\  & =16\cdot (0.984\,80…)\cdot n \\  & =(15.756\,92…)\cdot n \\  & ≈15.8n.\end{aligned}
$$
